limitations: Six-shape six-level independent FEM diagnostics, ten of thirty complete initial3% last-change diagnostics and three current-source contact controls pass. Original plotting/publisher failures remain exact. Complete free-body U grasp attempts remain unqualified despite updated friction derivatives and alternative numerical coordinates; the preserved near-singular rigid/contact modes and large Newton directions do not alone prove wrench infeasibility. Finer full fields are separately archived by geometry. Egg fine reference tasks, converged resolved egg/Franka/interior-hotspot contact, profile/count/history and warmed native accuracy/cost acceptance remain required. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
